description:
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, targeting North Pole Patrol.
If Fatestitcher has Hawkeye's Bow attached to it, Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Fatestitcher ability, untapping North Pole Patrol.
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, targeting Fatestitcher.
If North Pole Patrol has Hawkeye's Bow attached to it, Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the North Pole Patrol ability, untapping Fatestitcher.
Repeat.

uses.name: Hawkeye's Bow
uses.cardState: attached to either Fatestitcher or North Pole Patrol
